Tenant ID: Your organisation's unique ID. The IT admin gave you this when they created your DRM account.
X-DRM-Admin-Key: A shared secret that gates the /api/admin/* endpoints. Treat as a password — never paste it into chat or share it in tickets.
Admin user ID: Your DRM user UUID — required so audit logs attribute changes to a real person, not just an API key.
Watermark template: A reusable visible-watermark recipe (text + opacity + position). Set up once, apply to many files.
Watermark pattern: Text rendered on the page. Supports {user}, {file}, {time} tokens that the viewer expands at open time.
Policy template: A reusable bundle of permissions + watermark + offline lease. Apply once to many files.
OfflineLease: How long a viewer can open a protected file without contacting the server. Set to 0 to require live policy lookups every time.
Run macros: Permission for the recipient to run embedded Office macros (VBA code in Word/Excel/PowerPoint). Off by default for safety.
Allow ownership transfer: Permission for the recipient to become the new file owner. Use carefully — they can then revoke access for others.
Allow print: Permission for the viewer to send the document to a printer.
Entra tenant ID: Your Microsoft Entra ID directory. Usually looks like contoso.onmicrosoft.com or a GUID.
Client ID: App-registration GUID from your identity provider. The DRM server uses it to call Entra Graph or Box.
Client secret: Password for the app registration. Rotate at least yearly.
Enterprise ID: Box enterprise account ID. Found in your Box admin console under Settings → Business Settings.
Webhook signing secret: HMAC key that Box uses to sign webhook requests so DRM can verify they came from Box.
Skip domains: Recipient email domains that bypass auto-encrypt (e.g. internal domains).
Default policy template ID: Template applied automatically when the Outlook add-in protects an attachment.
Stale after: After this many minutes without a heartbeat, a device is considered stale and stops being treated as online.
Container passphrase: Human-typed secret used (with PBKDF2) to derive the AES-GCM key for a .drmcontainer.
Trailer secret: HMAC key that signs the transparent-encryption trailer. Generated by the operator; never sent to clients.
Recipient type: Whether the grant target is a User (single person) or a Group (everyone in the group).
Print watermark: Text overlay stamped onto the printed page (not just on screen). Useful to identify leaked photocopies.
Rolling watermark: When enabled, the on-screen watermark jitters position over time so a single photograph captures a unique pattern.
Anti-capture: Settings that make on-screen watermarks harder to crop out of a photograph (density, opacity, diagonal angle).
ScimBearerToken: Token your identity provider uses to call our SCIM endpoints when provisioning users.
Persona: Role-style profile that controls which DRM affordances a user sees: Employee, KnowledgeWorker, Executive, or Admin.
